title: Combined evidence set for classroom air temperature screening: ABNT NBR 17037:2023, RDC No. 886/2024, ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2023, ASHRAE Handbook 2023 Educational Facilities chapter, and a 2024 Brazilian university classroom field study
author_or_body: ABNT; ANVISA; ASHRAE; Elsevier article authors for the supporting field study
edition_year: ABNT NBR 17037:2023; RDC No. 886 dated July 10, 2024, published July 12, 2024 and rectified July 25, 2024; ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2023; 2023 ASHRAE Handbook HVAC Applications Chapter 8; Building and Environment article published June 15, 2024
source_type: Current technical standard, current revocation regulation, current HVAC standard, current handbook chapter, and supporting primary research article
normative_status: ABNT NBR 17037:2023, RDC No. 886/2024, and ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2023 are current. The ASHRAE Handbook chapter is current technical guidance. RE No. 9/2003 is historical and revoked by RDC No. 886/2024.
source_hierarchy: Highest weight for artificially conditioned non-residential classrooms in Brazil: ABNT NBR 17037:2023, with RDC No. 886/2024 confirming that RE No. 9/2003 is revoked. Highest weight for thermal-comfort interpretation and non-conditioned classrooms: ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2023 plus the 2023 ASHRAE Educational Facilities chapter. The 2024 Brazilian university classroom field study is supporting evidence and not a compliance source.
country_or_jurisdiction: Brazil for conditioned indoor-air-quality reference values; international for thermal-comfort interpretation.
environment_type: Occupied classroom or lecture classroom used during the evening period in a non-residential educational building.
occupant_profile: Predominantly healthy adolescents and adults, including students and instructor, performing sedentary learning activity.
education_stage: Higher education or adult education at night. [uncertain]
room_operation_mode: Three cases must be separated: artificially conditioned classroom, naturally ventilated classroom, and mixed-mode classroom. A fixed air-temperature screening band is directly defensible only for the first case. [uncertain]
operating_context: Evening occupancy with possible variation in windows, blinds, fans, air-conditioning schedule, and occupant density. The actual case-study classroom operating mode and control strategy were not provided. [uncertain]
excluded_conditions: Do not apply as a standalone comfort or compliance rule to preschoolers, sleeping occupants, high-metabolic activities, spaces dominated by radiant asymmetry, spaces with strong local drafts or direct solar gains not characterized, or any naturally ventilated or mixed-mode room assessed only by air temperature.
limit_or_range: For artificially conditioned non-residential indoor spaces, accessible excerpts of ABNT NBR 17037:2023 indicate a dry-bulb air temperature reference range of 21 to 26 °C. For school-classroom thermal comfort guidance derived from ASHRAE Standard 55 assumptions, the 2023 ASHRAE Handbook gives 21.9 to 25.0 °C in winter and 23.9 to 25.0 °C in summer for classrooms, laboratories, libraries, and auditoriums under stated assumptions. For naturally ventilated or mixed-mode classrooms, do not use one fixed air-temperature compliance range; use adaptive or operative-temperature assessment instead. [uncertain]
meaning_of_parameter: Operational screening for conditioned-space indoor environmental control and partial evidence for thermal comfort interpretation. It is not standalone proof of comfort, health protection, learning quality, or legal conformity in naturally ventilated classrooms.
spatial_reference_zone: Occupied zone representative of seated students and the instructor rather than facade edges or direct supply-air locations. [uncertain]
measurement_position: Place the sensor away from direct supply jets, direct sun patches, exterior walls or windows, occupants' bodies, luminaires, and other local heat sources. Prefer seated breathing-zone height, while treating the old 1.5 m practice from historical references only as a heuristic and not as a confirmed current normative requirement. [uncertain]
sensor_orientation: No special directional orientation is normally required for dry-bulb air temperature, but the sensor should be shielded from radiant heating and direct airflow bias.
spatial_representativeness: A single fixed node is a point measurement and represents only its local microenvironment unless verified against room gradients or multiple positions.
unmeasured_relevant_variables: Mean radiant temperature, operative temperature, air speed, relative humidity, clothing insulation, metabolic rate, adaptive opportunities such as operable windows and fans, outdoor running-mean temperature, solar gains, occupancy density, and vertical air-temperature gradient.
instrument_specification: Accessible excerpts of ABNT NBR 17037:2023 indicate minimum temperature-instrument sensitivity of 0.1 °C, accuracy of ±0.5 °C, and minimum annual calibration. The installed low-cost prototype sensor may not meet this laboratory-grade benchmark. [uncertain]
calibration_status: Use traceable comparison against a calibrated reference. Accessible excerpts of ABNT NBR 17037:2023 require verification and adjustment with traceable standards and indicate minimum annual calibration for temperature instruments. The current prototype calibration evidence was not provided. [uncertain]
response_time: Only interpret the value after local thermal equilibrium is reached. No parameter-specific dashboard response-time criterion was identified in the consulted current sources. [uncertain]
sensor_hysteresis_and_drift: Low-cost sensors may show hysteresis and drift that can shift threshold crossings near band edges. No project-specific quantified drift evidence was available. [uncertain]
sampling_interval: Use the raw acquisition interval configured in the prototype. The consulted current sources did not prescribe a specific real-time sampling interval for dashboard alerting. [uncertain]
valid_data_requirement: For any rolling alert window, require at least 80% valid samples and reject obvious startup or fault values. This is an engineering data-quality rule rather than a normative threshold. [uncertain]
gap_and_outlier_handling: Treat communication gaps, warm-up periods, implausible spikes, and sensor faults as insufficient data rather than as thermal events. Do not impute missing values for alert decisions. [uncertain]
aggregation_window: Recommended dashboard implementation: a 15-minute moving average for state display plus optional raw-trend visualization. No current normative persistence window was identified. [uncertain]
trigger_rule: For artificially conditioned classrooms only, set Attention when the 15-minute moving average is below 21 °C or above 26 °C. If a stronger state is needed, reserve Alert for sustained deviation beyond the same band for at least 30 minutes. For naturally ventilated or mixed-mode classrooms, do not use a fixed air-temperature threshold as a compliance alert; evaluate with adaptive or operative-temperature logic instead. [uncertain]
clear_rule: Clear the state only after the same 15-minute moving average returns to 21.2 to 25.8 °C for one full window to avoid alert chatter. This hysteresis is an engineering choice, not a normative rule. [uncertain]
rule_basis: The conditioned-space band comes from accessible excerpts of ABNT NBR 17037:2023. The decision not to use one fixed air-temperature threshold for naturally ventilated or mixed-mode classrooms follows the applicability logic of ANSI/ASHRAE Standard 55-2023 and the supporting Brazilian university classroom field study, which reported different neutral temperatures by operation mode. Persistence, hysteresis, and data-completeness rules are internal engineering choices. [uncertain]
dashboard_state: Suggested states are Normal, Attention, Alert, and Insufficient data. Normal means only that the screened air-temperature condition is inside the selected band, not that full thermal comfort has been demonstrated. [uncertain]
dashboard_message: Example conditioned-space message: 'Indoor air temperature is currently outside the 21-26 °C reference band used for artificially conditioned non-residential spaces.' Example naturally ventilated message: 'Measured indoor air temperature is outside the project screening band, but thermal comfort cannot be determined from air temperature alone.' [uncertain]
possible_management_investigation: Check whether the room was in natural ventilation, mixed mode, or mechanical cooling; verify windows, blinds, fans, AC schedule and setpoint, sensor placement, occupancy surge, and exposure to sun or supply jets. Do not infer the root cause from air temperature alone.
interpretation_limits: Air temperature alone does not establish operative temperature, PMV or PPD, adaptive acceptability, health risk, learning impact, or legal noncompliance. A single-point reading cannot demonstrate whole-room conditions or comfort for all occupants.
overinterpretation_risk: Users may incorrectly read a temperature alert as proof of discomfort, HVAC failure, unsafe conditions, or reduced learning performance. That inference is not supported without additional variables and contextual checks.
project_requirement: Provide a transparent dashboard indicator for the TCC that distinguishes screened air-temperature deviation from actual thermal-comfort diagnosis and separates current conditioned-space reference values from historical revoked criteria.
destination_in_text: Use in the literature review on indoor environmental quality, the methods section that explains alert logic, the results and discussion section on dashboard interpretation limits, and the conclusion on prototype scope.
verification_state: Partially verified in primary and current sources: RDC No. 886/2024 revocation status, ASHRAE Standard 55 applicability framing, ASHRAE Handbook classroom design ranges, and the 2024 Brazilian classroom field-study findings were checked directly. Exact ABNT NBR 17037 numeric thresholds and instrument specifications were checked through accessible secondary excerpts because the full ABNT text is paywalled. [uncertain]
